title: Use of Prospectus Format for Public Offering
text:
Ministry of Finance
Securities and Exchange Commission
Instruction (5/2016)
Use of Prospectus Format for Public Offering
Under Section 71 (b), Chapter X III of the Securities Exchange Law (Law), the
Securities and Exchange Commission of Myanmar (SECM) hereby issues an
instruction for the use of prospectus format for public offering.
1. According to section 5 (a) of Notification (2/2015) of Securities and Exchange
Commission of Myanmar (SECM), public companies which make public offering
shall prepare prospectus based on a format derived by SECM. Public companies need
to submit such prospectus to SECM and obtain approval of public offering from
SECM according to section 35 (a) of the Law.
2. The format is as below.
Number of persons whom the Offering amount Format of
issuer makes offer to buy shares (million kyat) Prospectus
Less than 100 Less than 500 Form A
Less than 100 Equal to or more than 500 Form B
Equal to or more than 100 Less than 500 Form B
Equal to or more than 100 Equal to or more than 500 Form B
Chairman
Securities and Exchange Commission of Myanmar
